summary_1line: Nala is publicly welcomed in Bhima’s city, reconciles with Rituparna through mutual forgiveness and knowledge exchange, then prepares to reclaim his kingdom from Pushkara.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Nala and Damayanti, adorned in ornaments, bow before King Bhima as a jubilant city decorated with flowers and banners celebrates their return.
Nala and King Rituparna stand facing each other in court, exchanging the secret sciences of horsemanship and dice with solemn ritual.
Nala confronts Pushkara with fierce resolve, offering a final choice between a high-stakes dice game and single combat to reclaim his ancestral kingdom.
